import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    hist = inputs["DIM_EMP_HIST"].copy()
    queries = inputs["ASOF_QUERIES"].copy()

    # Coerce types
    hist["emp_id"] = hist["emp_id"]
    hist["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(hist["eff_start_date"])
    hist["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(hist["eff_end_date"])

    queries["emp_id"] = queries["emp_id"]
    queries["as_of_date"] = pd.to_datetime(queries["as_of_date"])

    # Inner join on emp_id
    merged = queries.merge(hist, on="emp_id", how="inner", suffixes=("", "_h"))

    # Apply interval conditions: as_of_date >= eff_start_date
    #                             AND (eff_end_date IS NULL OR as_of_date < eff_end_date)
    cond_start = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    cond_end = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"])

    result = merged[cond_start & cond_end]

    out = result[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"asof_result": out}
